describes: Pre-ADR-0026 replication cost: bare SnapshotBatch frames and an EntitySnapshot without content_id, name_key, level, faction, health, max_health or alive.
methodology: One subscriber, all-entities interest. snapshot.batch_bytes is proto.Size of the published SnapshotBatch; bytes_per_second scales it by 1000/snapshot_interval_ms. step percentiles are per-step nanoseconds over 300 samples, each timing a window of 2000 consecutive Zone.step() calls, because the Windows monotonic clock rounds one step to zero. A move intent is applied before each window, so roughly the first seven steps of a window integrate the player and the rest walk the registry only.
